qualifier: pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and breakdown
name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and breakdown
rationale: All members concern nucleotide/nucleoside interconversion, centred on pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism (plus NUDT/thiopurine handling), unlike confusables built on purine ribonucleotide de novo synthesis or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: biosynthesis, turnover and homeostasis
name: Sphingolipid biosynthesis, turnover and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover sphingolipid/ceramide (amide, membrane lipid) synthesis, catabolism and its regulation, whereas confusables add lipid transfer between membranes or TNFR1/sphingomyelinase-driven ceramide production.

qualifier: formation and triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet formation and triglyceride storage
rationale: All members concern building lipid droplets and maintaining intracellular triglyceride/fatty acid stores, distinct from confusables centred on droplet breakdown (lipophagy), phospholipid regulation or LXR-driven lipogenesis.

qualifier: chemokine receptor-guided, monocyte-centred
name: Chemokine receptor-guided monocyte and leukocyte migration
rationale: Members are chemokine/receptor clusters and regulators of monocyte, macrophage and NK chemotaxis, distinguished from confusables focused on monocyte activation, endothelial adhesion/extravasation or CCR1/CCR7 signalling.

qualifier: social, exploratory and reward-conditioned
name: Social, exploratory and reward-conditioned behavior
rationale: Members are mating, aggressive, parental, grooming, exploratory and drug/conditioned-reward behaviors (with amygdala development), whereas confusables emphasize stress hormone, neuropeptide or sleep-wake processes.

qualifier: canonical processing and paralog-specific NICD target transcription
name: Canonical Notch processing and paralog-specific NICD target transcription
rationale: All members describe Notch receptor cleavage and intracellular-domain-driven transcription across NOTCH1-4 and developmental contexts (Th2, pancreas), distinct from confusables centred on NOTCH1 PEST/FBXW7 cancer mutants or noncanonical NOTCH3/NOTCH4 activation.

qualifier: innate receptor-triggered via TAK1/IKK, including NOD1/2 and noncanonical NF-kB
name: Innate receptor-triggered TAK1/IKK activation of NF-kB and JNK/p38
rationale: Members trace TLR, NOD1/2, Dectin-1 and TNFSF signals through TAK1/IKK/NIK to NF-kB and JNK/p38, distinguished from confusables dominated by TNFR1 signalling, negative NF-kB feedback/linear ubiquitination or TBK1-IRF3.

qualifier: nephric duct and metanephric nephron tubule
name: Nephric duct and metanephric nephron tubule development
rationale: All members concern nephric duct and nephron formation and segment differentiation (renal vesicle to loop of Henle), whereas confusables centre on ureteric bud induction and kidney size.

qualifier: fibronectin-integrin focal adhesion and fibroblast migration
name: Integrin-fibronectin focal adhesion and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link integrin production, fibronectin matrix, focal adhesion assembly and SRF-driven cytoskeleton to fibroblast migration, unlike confusables centred on EMT, syndecan/stress fibres or integrin surface interactions.

qualifier: endothelial and smooth muscle cell specification
name: Vascular endothelial and smooth muscle cell specification
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate commitment, arterial/venous/lymphatic differentiation, vasculogenesis and vascular smooth muscle development, distinct from confusables centred on BMP signalling, outflow tract, pulmonary or valve morphogenesis.

qualifier: metallothionein detoxification and redox control
name: Metal ion response, metallothionein detoxification and redox control
rationale: Members are responses to copper, zinc, manganese, iron, mercury, lead, cobalt and selenium with MTF1/metallothionein and HMOX1/redox regulation, distinguished from confusables on ferroptosis, xenobiotics, ROS detoxification or cadmium.

qualifier: synaptic vesicle docking, priming and multi-transmitter release cycles
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and multi-transmitter release cycles
rationale: All members concern SNARE-dependent vesicle docking, priming and Ca2+-triggered exocytosis including ACh, glutamate and monoamine release cycles, unlike confusables on presynaptic inhibition, plasticity or active-zone maintenance.

qualifier: peroxide and nitrosative stress governing intrinsic apoptosis
name: Peroxide and nitrosative stress responses governing intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, hydroperoxides, NO and reactive nitrogen and their control of stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis, distinct from confusables on ferroptosis, ischemia or mitochondrial respiration.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water and epithelial salt transport
name: Osmoregulation via vasopressin-aquaporin water and epithelial salt transport
rationale: Members span osmotic stress responses, vasopressin/aquaporin water handling and renal/epithelial Na+, K+, Cl- transport (CFTR, SLC12 cotransporters), unlike confusables on aldosterone synthesis, Na+/H+ exchangers or generic ion homeostasis.

qualifier: aldehyde detoxification and vitamin B6 cofactors
name: Glutathione-sulfur metabolism, aldehyde detoxification and vitamin B6 cofactors
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis/recycling, cysteine and sulfide metabolism, methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and cofactor (B6, molybdenum) metabolism, with vitamin B6 separating it from selenium/transsulfuration and ROS confusables.

qualifier: MITF-driven, with light response
name: MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation and light response
rationale: Members concern MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis, pigment granule positioning, melanocyte growth/differentiation and UV/blue-light responses, distinct from confusables on MITF-M proliferation/DNA repair or melanosome assembly.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA regulation of glycogen and triglyceride
name: Glucagon-PKA regulation of glycogen and triglyceride turnover
rationale: Members link glucagon/PKA, AMPK, adiponectin and glucokinase to glycogen and triglyceride synthesis and breakdown, unlike confusables on gluconeogenesis, ChREBP glucose sensing or insulin signalling.

qualifier: MECP2-dependent, with sensory behavior
name: MECP2-dependent neuronal gene regulation and sensory behavior
rationale: Members centre on MECP2 (Rett) chromatin repression with HDACs, neuronal translation control and touch/proprioceptive/visual behaviors, distinguished from confusables on glycinergic transmission or locomotor/vocal behavior.

qualifier: NOTCH3/4 and p75NTR
name: Regulated intramembrane proteolysis of NOTCH3/4 and p75NTR
rationale: All members describe receptor cleavage releasing intracellular domains (Notch processing, NOTCH3/NOTCH4, p75NTR-NRIF), with p75NTR separating it from ERBB4 and NOTCH1/2 confusables.

qualifier: driving convergent extension
name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and the convergent extension it drives in gastrulation, axis elongation, organogenesis and neural plate, unlike confusables on Wnt5a internalization or axial/paraxial mesoderm.

qualifier: stress, sleep-wake and social
name: Neuropeptide control of stress, sleep-wake and social behavior
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/GPCR signalling (orexin, relaxin) with CRH/corticosterone stress, sleep-wake and mating/aggressive behaviors, distinct from confusables on opioid/dense-core vesicle signalling or grooming/conditioning behavior.

qualifier: Th2-, mast cell- and eosinophil-mediated
name: Th2-, mast cell- and eosinophil-mediated type 2 immunity
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13/33 signalling, FcepsilonRI mast cell and eosinophil responses and IgE switching, unlike confusables built on IL-2/7/15, IL-10/12/23/27 or IL-6-family signalling.

qualifier: follicle and oocyte maturation to luteolysis
name: Ovarian cycle from follicle and oocyte maturation to luteolysis
rationale: Members span follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and estrous cycle, distinct from confusables centred on gonadotropin hormone signalling or Sertoli cells.

qualifier: capping, C-strand replication and recombination control
name: Telomere capping, C-strand replication and recombination control
rationale: All members concern telomerase-independent end maintenance (capping, C-strand fill-in, D-loop/t-circle and recombination control), unlike confusables on telomerase/Cajal body, ATRX/DAXX defects or general fork processing.

qualifier: formyl peptide and complement receptor-driven
name: Formyl peptide and complement receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment
rationale: Members are GPCR (formyl peptide) and complement receptor signalling driving neutrophil chemotaxis, recruitment and fate, distinguished from confusables on chemokine production, extravasation or hydroxycarboxylic acid receptors.
